summary.text: Lina Wagner is the Democratic candidate for the Connecticut House of Representatives, District 51, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she is running against incumbent Chris Stewart (R / Independent Party of Connecticut).
Her campaign website, which uses the name Dr. Lina Wagner, describes a campaign focused on the Quiet Corner.

paragraphs.text: On her campaign website, Wagner writes that she never planned to run for office and became involved after seeing community members searching for answers about issues affecting their homes and families.
She says she would focus on supporting working families, advocating for veterans and seniors, strengthening public education, and ensuring growth happens responsibly with community input.
